result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your blood test (HbA1c) was done on 16 September 2026. The result was 58 mmol/mol.

The letter asks you to keep taking your medicine, metformin, for now. Your dose may be increased. This will be talked about at your review.

## What you need to do
1. Keep taking metformin 500 milligrams twice a day for now.
2. Go to your review on Monday 9 November 2026.

## Dates and medicines
- 16 September 2026: the date of your HbA1c blood test.
- Monday 9 November 2026: your review appointment. You will talk about raising your metformin dose.
- Metformin: 500 milligrams, twice a day. No change for now. Keep taking it the same way.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does my HbA1c result of 58 mmol/mol mean for me?
- What is metformin, and how does it work?
- What will we decide about my metformin dose at the review?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
